result.instructions: Tools for Order Desk, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which orders in my New folder were added in the last 3 days?"; "Show me order 736745 with its items and shipments."; "Add tracking number 9400111899223 (USPS) to order 736745 and move it to the Shipped folder.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Order Desk data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run orderdesk_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run orderdesk_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run orderdesk_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. orderdesk_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: orderdesk_get_store
tools.title: Get store settings and folders
tools.description: The store's name, id, FOLDERS (id -> name; orders live in exactly one folder, and folder ids are needed to filter and move orders) and key settings (timezone, locale, stock behavior, shipping methods). The API key and mail credentials are never returned. GET /store.

tools.name: orderdesk_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: Search orders, newest first, with items, addresses, totals, payment and shipments. Filters combine with AND. Prefer a date range: Order Desk asks clients to avoid open-ended queries. Page with limit and offset (next_offset). GET /orders.

folder_id.description: Folder id, or several separated by commas (see orderdesk_get_store).

folder_name.description: The folder's exact name instead of its id.

source_id.description: Your original order id from the cart or marketplace.

added_from.description: Orders added on or after this time (a date means the start of that UTC day).

added_to.description: Orders added on or before this time (a date means the end of that UTC day).

modified_from.description: Orders modified on or after this time.

modified_to.description: Orders modified on or before this time.

customer_id.description: Customer id in the originating system.

include_history.description: Include each order's history (slow; use with a small limit).

order_by.description: Order field to sort by (default date_added).

offset.description: Records to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: orderdesk_get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: One order by Order Desk's internal id: addresses, items, totals, payment, notes, discounts, checkout data and shipments. To find an order by your own id, use orderdesk_list_orders with source_id. GET /orders/{order_id}.

order_id.description: Order Desk's internal order id (not the cart's order number).

tools.name: orderdesk_list_order_items
tools.title: List order items
tools.description: The line items of one order (name, SKU, price, quantity, weight, delivery type, variations). GET /orders/{order_id}/order-items.

tools.name: orderdesk_list_order_shipments
tools.title: List order shipments
tools.description: The shipments recorded against an order: carrier, tracking number and URL, method, weight, cost, dates. GET /orders/{order_id}/shipments.

tools.name: orderdesk_create_order
tools.title: Create order
tools.description: WRITE: add a new order to the store. Needs at least one item, and a name or company in the shipping or customer address (if only one address is given the other is copied from it). Omit folder_id to land in the first folder. Order Desk rejects an order it recognizes as a duplicate and names the existing order id. POST /orders.

metadata.description: Hidden item details (max 15,000 characters as JSON).

country.description: Country code or full country name.
Country code or full country name.

source_id.description: Your own order id (the order's Order Desk id is used when blank).

source_name.description: Order source / cart name (default Order Desk).

folder_id.description: Folder to put the order in (see orderdesk_get_store).

checkout_data.description: Editable extra order details (max 3,500 characters as JSON).

order_metadata.description: Hidden extra order details (max 2,000 characters as JSON).

tools.name: orderdesk_update_order
tools.title: Update order
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing order. Order Desk's PUT replaces the whole record, so this reads the order, applies only the fields you pass (shipping/customer address fields and checkout_data/order_metadata keys are merged into what is there, other values replaced) and sends the complete record back, items included. The order keeps its folder; use orderdesk_move_orders to move it. PUT /orders/{order_id}.

shipping.description: Shipping address fields to change (others are kept).

country.description: Country code or full country name.

customer.description: Customer address fields to change (others are kept).

country.description: Country code or full country name.

checkout_data.description: Checkout data keys to set (other keys are kept).

order_metadata.description: Order metadata keys to set (other keys are kept).

tools.name: orderdesk_add_order_item
tools.title: Add order item
tools.description: WRITE: add one line item to an existing order; Order Desk recalculates the totals. POST /orders/{order_id}/order-items.

metadata.description: Hidden item details (max 15,000 characters as JSON).

item.description: The line item to add (name, code, price, quantity...).

tools.name: orderdesk_add_order_note
tools.title: Add order history note
tools.description: WRITE: append an entry to an order's history. History is append-only (entries cannot be edited or removed) and an order holds at most 250 entries, so do not use it for routine polling. POST /orders/{order_id}/order-history.

tools.name: orderdesk_add_shipment
tools.title: Add shipment
tools.description: WRITE: record a shipment (carrier and tracking number) against an order. One shipment per parcel; several shipments represent a partial fulfillment. Use "n/a" when there is no tracking number. If tracking_url is omitted Order Desk derives it. POST /orders/{order_id}/shipments.

carrier_code.description: Carrier code such as USPS or FedEx.

shipment_method.description: Shipping service name, e.g. First Class International.

cost.description: Your cost to send the shipment.

tools.name: orderdesk_move_orders
tools.title: Move orders to a folder
tools.description: WRITE: move one or more orders to another folder. Moving runs the rules attached to the destination folder (which can send e-mail, call fulfillment services, etc.) and writes a history entry. Pass exactly one of destination_folder_id or destination_folder_name (see orderdesk_get_store). Returns each order's previous folder. POST /move-orders.

destination_folder_name.description: Exact folder name to move to.

tools.name: orderdesk_list_inventory_items
tools.title: List inventory items
tools.description: Search the store's inventory (SKU, name, price, cost, weight, stock, location). Order Desk returns every match with no paging, so narrow with search/code/name; limit and offset slice the result here. GET /inventory-items.

search.description: Matches name, code and metadata together.

updated_from.description: Items updated on or after this time.

offset.description: Records to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: orderdesk_get_inventory_item
tools.title: Get inventory item
tools.description: One inventory item by Order Desk's internal id. GET /inventory-items/{inventory_item_id}.

inventory_item_id.description: Order Desk's internal inventory item id (see orderdesk_list_inventory_items).

tools.name: orderdesk_create_inventory_item
tools.title: Create inventory item
tools.description: WRITE: add an inventory item. The code (SKU) must match the code your orders arrive with. POST /inventory-items.

tools.name: orderdesk_update_inventory_item
tools.title: Update inventory item
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an inventory item, for example its stock count. Order Desk's PUT replaces the whole record, so this reads the item, applies only the fields you pass (metadata and variation keys are merged) and sends the complete record back. PUT /inventory-items/{inventory_item_id}.

inventory_item_id.description: Order Desk's internal inventory item id.

stock.description: The new units-available count (replaces the old one).

variation_list.description: Variation keys to set (others are kept).

metadata.description: Metadata keys to set (others are kept).

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Order Desk
prompts.description: What you can do with Order Desk here, with example requests to try.
